before: public members are accessible externally; protected members are accessible within the permitted inheritance scope; private members are accessible only within the declaring class. Visibility supports an interface boundary, not authentication.
Here the balance field is private. deposit checks its input before updating it, and balance() exposes a read operation. A caller cannot bypass this method by assigning the private property directly.
